title: EMPLOYEE table of the OFFICE database
body:
An organisation keeps the table EMPLOYEE(EmpNo, Ename, Salary, Bonus, DeptId) in its OFFICE database. A blank bonus is stored as NULL. The table holds the following records:

EmpNo | Ename | Salary | Bonus | DeptId
101 | Aaliya | 10000 | 234 | D02
102 | Kritika | 60000 | 123 | D01
103 | Shabbir | 45000 | 566 | D01
104 | Gurpreet | 19000 | 565 | D04
105 | Joseph | 34000 | 875 | D03
106 | Sanya | 48000 | 695 | D02
107 | Vergese | 15000 | NULL | D01
108 | Nachaobi | 29000 | NULL | D05
109 | Daribha | 42000 | NULL | D04
110 | Tanya | 50000 | 467 | D05

The HR manager asks a student intern to write SELECT queries on this table to answer some questions.
